operator_request: Create a dedicated Phase 0D benchmark-design work packet, ensure it is completed before WP-FF-011, commit and push the packet changes, then start WP-FF-010.

implementation_research_refresh.trigger: The existing August planning basis leaves the implementation statistics source and environment identities unpinned; this refresh addresses those named gaps only.
implementation_research_refresh.observed_patterns: Criterion retains paired observations during resampling and derives percentile confidence intervals from the resulting distribution; NIST distinguishes outlier labeling from silently deleting observations.
implementation_research_refresh.selected_approach: Reuse existing serde, SHA256, artifact and report primitives. Implement a bounded Ferric-owned paired-cluster percentile bootstrap with retained raw samples, deterministic declared resampling, explicit noise/outlier refusal, and strict concrete-work admission before statistical processing. No statistics dependency is present in the workspace, and Criterion identifies its statistics API as an unstable implementation detail.
implementation_research_refresh.rejected_options: Adding Criterion, Hyperfine or another runtime; shell-composed measurement; independent resampling that destroys pair/cluster correlation; dropping inconvenient raw samples; treating synthetic fixture timings as measured performance.
implementation_research_refresh.risks_and_controls: Externally supplied timing records remain untrusted. Bind artifacts and observations, compare all work dimensions before statistics, resample independent paired clusters, reject missing/duplicate/noisy data and crossing confidence bounds, retain unavailable metrics explicitly, and keep every design report below product or performance acceptance.
implementation_research_refresh.verification: Public input parser and admission boundary; deterministic cheaper-work/provenance/topology/cache/sample/noise/statistical counterexamples; independent algorithm and source review; actual host observations only when collected, with unavailable fields explicit. No live benchmark campaign or performance claim.

sources_checked.relevant_pattern: Equivalent work and correctness gate sample admission before timing, with pinned topology, raw metrics, distributions, and confidence bounds.
Phase 0D is non-product design evidence and must version manifests and reports.
Warmup, raw sample analysis, bootstrap confidence intervals, noise thresholds, and explicit caution about environment-driven false changes.
Cross-platform command benchmarking with warmup, preparation, outlier detection, and machine-readable export; useful as a field pattern, not selected as a Ferric dependency.
Repetitions, warmup, context, raw file output, custom statistics, and performance-counter reporting.
Linux counter collection supports machine-readable JSON but is platform-specific and must remain an optional declared measurement surface.
Windows power-plan state materially affects benchmark behavior and belongs in the host profile.

selected_approach: Keep equivalence predicates, sample admission, statistics policy, and report schemas Ferric-owned and strict.
Retain raw samples and normalized observations; aggregate reports never replace them.
Use typed platform measurement adapters whose unavailable metrics remain explicit without changing equality semantics.
Require behavior-changing negative fixtures before accepting timing data.
Defer any dependency selection until source, license, transitive graph, reproducibility, and need are measured during promotion.
rejected_options: A single mean or one-machine result as a gate.
Using Criterion.rs alone for cross-process equivalent-work system benchmarks.
Using Hyperfine shell command composition as canonical proof.
Making Bencher or another hosted service a canonical dependency.
Making yt-dlp or an external comparison executable mandatory for canonical build, test, verification, package, or release.
reuse_opportunities: Reuse the WP-004 compatibility corpus and normalized observation planes.
Reuse xtask strict-schema, report, fixture, and counterfactual patterns.
Reuse stable IDs and provenance hashes across diagnostics and benchmark artifacts.
Reuse `.fforager-artifacts/` for all disposable benchmark output.
basis.validation_plan: At promotion, bind exact source/tool versions and host profiles; implement strict schemas and public equality admission; execute isolated cheaper-work, provenance, topology, cache, raw-sample, single-mean, and noise mutations; run canonical gates and an independent HIGH-risk adversarial review; close only the non-product design contract with no product-path change.

base_scope: Ferric-owned versioned benchmark manifests, normalized observations, raw samples, equality admission, rejection diagnostics, and aggregate reports
Replayable Windows and Unix host profiles with explicit metric availability and noise policy
Randomized paired sampling, raw-sample retention, distributions, and 95-percent confidence-bound gates
Deterministic unequal-work, provenance, cache, topology, missing-sample, and single-mean counterexamples
No-context xtask help and machine-readable failure/recovery output

performance_contract.claim_rule: Samples enter timing only after equality passes; upper confidence bounds govern no-regression and lower confidence bounds govern any improvement claim; a single mean never passes.

high_roi_additions.addition: Use one provenance-bound run-manifest digest as the join key for equality observations, raw samples, diagnostics, faults, and aggregate reports.
high_roi_additions.why_high_roi: All surfaces already need the same identities, so one join key cheaply prevents mixed-run evidence and improves parallel-agent attribution.
high_roi_additions.gap_closed: Plausible reports from different source, tool, corpus, cache, or topology states could otherwise be combined.
high_roi_additions.validation: Aggregation rejects every artifact whose manifest digest differs.

high_roi_additions.addition: Retain raw samples and deterministic equality-rejection replay bundles for every failed admission.
high_roi_additions.why_high_roi: The gate already computes these observations, so retention makes later regressions and agent handoffs reproducible without another noisy run.
high_roi_additions.gap_closed: Aggregate-only evidence hides false equivalence, lost samples, and environmental noise.
high_roi_additions.validation: A fresh no-context replay reproduces the same normalized rejection offline.

high_roi_additions.addition: Separate platform measurement adapters from Ferric-owned equality and statistics policy.
high_roi_additions.why_high_roi: Platform counters differ while admission semantics must remain portable, letting later packets add metrics without rewriting correctness policy.
high_roi_additions.gap_closed: One unavailable OS counter could otherwise disable the benchmark or silently change its meaning.
high_roi_additions.validation: Windows and Unix fixtures produce the same equality verdict while declaring platform-specific metric availability.

assumptions: The current design and committed compatibility corpus remain canonical.
Optional comparison execution is observational and non-canonical.
Windows and Unix measurement capabilities differ and must be declared rather than silently normalized away.

The live FF-GATE-RUNTIME-001 changed-path classifier cannot currently validate a build-only PREREQUISITE; promotion remains blocked until a separately authorized classifier remediation preserves the Phase 0 prerequisite/NONE distinction without requiring token product code.
non_goals: Performance claims or release thresholds without measured variance.
A new runtime, native dependency, hosted service, or shell-based canonical path.

minimum_controls: Raw samples and normalized observations remain linked to one manifest digest.
Deliberately cheaper work fails before timing.
Confidence bounds and noise policy fail closed.
Canonical proof succeeds with optional comparison tools absent.
plausible_failures: A faster sample omitted required work.
A report mixed different builds or hosts.
One side received a warm cache or cheaper topology.
An aggregate hid missing or rejected samples.
A hosted or external tool became an undeclared prerequisite.
